title: Can't get past objective 1 in fresh AAPS install with NSClientV3
symptom: In a fresh AAPS 3.2.0.3 install with NSClientV3 configured and all uploads enabled, BG is uploaded to Nightscout but the objective regarding this does not get completed.
cause: The issue was fixed by a commit, implying a bug in the code related to NSClientV3 objective completion.
fix: Workaround: switch to NSClientV1 to complete the objective, then switch back. The issue was fixed by commit 172075ebf80a929004dfd8be5d8863beda42712b.
evidence_quote: Workaround is to select NSClientV1, then objective gets completed.
